newsitem.title: KUWAIT: BAe unit in Kuwait arms offset deal.
newsitem.headline: BAe unit in Kuwait arms offset deal.

text.p: British Aerospace Australia on Wednesday signed a $4.5 million offset pledge with Kuwait, the official Kuwait News Agency reported.

The pledge is to offset an order by Kuwait for 22 S-600 series armoured personnel vehicles worth about $16 million. The Kuwait National Guard order, which includes training and support, was announced in March.
The agency quoted a Kuwaiti offset official as saying a total of 18 firms have such accords with Kuwait worth more than $1.5 billion.

Companies with Kuwait government orders of one million dinars ($3.3 million) or more are obliged to reinvest 30 percent of a deals worth mainly in Kuwait or in a Gulf Arab state. Rules of the offset programme, launched in 1992, say foreign suppliers could also invest in other Arab or world states.
